problem.label: The problem
items: Patent filings are growing fast, yet only about 0.1% of intellectual assets are commercialised.
High legal risk and enforcement costs make businesses hesitant to exploit patents.
Patent insurance exists in many countries, but Vietnam has no clear legal basis for it.

goals.label: Research objectives
items: Build the theoretical basis for patents, patent risk and patent insurance.
Show why patent insurance is needed and feasible in Vietnam.
Draw lessons from China, the United States, the European Union and Japan.
Propose legal reforms and a phased development strategy.

questions.label: Research questions
items: What is patent insurance, and on what basis can it develop?
How do international and Vietnamese law and practice approach patent insurance?
What model and legal mechanism does Vietnam need to develop patent insurance and strengthen its innovation ecosystem?
